paper.title_en: Non-singular Brane/Bubble Cosmologies in the Presence of String Cloud
paper.abstract_en: We investigate the cosmological evolution of a four-dimensional brane/bubble universe embedded in a five-dimensional Anti-de Sitter bulk containing a uniformly distributed cloud of strings. The endpoints of the strings attached to the brane induce an effective matter component in the four-dimensional universe. We derive the Friedmann equations for both the Randall-Sundrum braneworld and the shellworld (dark bubble) scenarios and show that one can obtain a nonsingular bounce in both the brane and bubble universes under certain conditions of the black hole mass and the four-dimensional cosmological constant. Though the bounce due to the spatial curvature occurs outside the black hole horizon, however, the bounce obtained due to the presence of string cloud in the braneworld scenario suffers from the Cauchy horizon instability as the bounce occurs inside the Cauchy horizon of the black hole. In contrast, for the shellworld scenario, the bounce can be made to occur outside the black hole horizon, thereby avoiding the horizon instability. We also analyze the field fluctuations on the brane/bubble and show that the fluctuations remain finite and well-behaved at the bounce point.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文探讨了弦云存在下的非奇异膜/泡泡宇宙学，涉及弗里德曼方程的推导、反弹条件及视界稳定性分析，属于广义相对论基础领域，具有理论深度和新颖性。
decision.title_zh: 弦云存在下的非奇异膜/泡泡宇宙学
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个嵌入五维反德西特（AdS）体中的四维膜/泡泡宇宙的宇宙学演化，其中体含有均匀分布的弦云。附着在膜上的弦的端点诱导了四维宇宙中的有效物质组分。我们推导了Randall-Sundrum膜世界和壳世界（暗泡泡）情景的弗里德曼方程，并表明在黑洞质量和四维宇宙学常数的某些条件下，在膜宇宙和泡泡宇宙中都可以获得非奇异反弹。虽然由空间曲率引起的反弹发生在黑洞视界之外，但是在膜世界情景中由弦云引起的反弹却遭受柯西视界不稳定性，因为反弹发生在黑洞的柯西视界内部。相比之下，对于壳世界情景，反弹可以发生在黑洞视界之外，从而避免了视界不稳定性。我们还分析了膜/泡泡上的场涨落，并表明这些涨落在反弹点是有限且行为良好的。
